Common Pests

Pests that pressure Farms & Facilities

Use these profiles to recognize common pressure points around Wisconsin farms, warehouses, and food sites — then connect to the service that fits your facility.

Image Coming Soon

Rodents

Mice and rats contaminate feed, damage materials, and exploit small structural openings around farms and warehouses.

View Rodent Control
Image Coming Soon

Cockroaches

Thrive in warm, moist equipment areas and food-handling spaces. Early sanitation and crack treatments matter.

Open Cockroach Guide
Image Coming Soon

Flies

Common around dairies, manure areas, and food facilities. Source reduction and targeted programs reduce pressure.

View Farm Pest Programs
Image Coming Soon

Ants

Trail into kitchens, break rooms, and storage areas through foundation gaps and moisture pathways.

View Commercial Pest Control
Image Coming Soon

Birds

Nesting on roofs, ledges, and vents creates contamination and maintenance issues for commercial buildings.

View Wildlife Removal
Image Coming Soon

Stored-Product Insects

Threaten grain bins, feed mills, and commodity storage when sanitation and monitoring slip.
